slides.title:
Start with
its graha
slides.subtitle: Every part of life has a graha that carries it

slides.label: Rule 12
slides.title:
Find the carrier
first
body: To study one matter of life, Nadi first finds the graha that signifies it, its karaka. Then it reads everything from there.
slides.note: R. G. Rao, Bhrigu Nandi Nadi, introduction

items.head: Venus
items.line: Wealth, and the graha looked to for marriage

slides.label: Then look around it
slides.title:
Who is near
your graha?
body: Who sits with it, who stands behind and ahead of it, and who faces it.

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title:
One question,
one graha
body: Asking about work? Find Saturn in your chart first. Asking about study? Find Mercury.

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Call the right desk
body: A question about a bill goes to billing. A question about a delivery goes to shipping. Each part of life has its own desk.
